part.text: Alpine with `apk` and `wget`, running as uid 1001 (not root). Let me test internet access and whether I can install packages.

input.command:
echo "--- internet via wget ---"
wget -q -O /dev/null -T 10 https://www.plantuml.com/plantuml/svg/ 2>&1 && echo "plantuml.com reachable" || echo "plantuml.com NOT reachable (exit $?)"
wget -q -O /dev/null -T 10 https://registry.npmjs.org/ 2>&1 && echo "npmjs reachable" || echo "npmjs NOT reachable (exit $?)"
echo "--- apk read test ---"
apk info 2>&1 | head -3
echo "--- can I write to /usr? ---"
touch /usr/.writetest 2>&1 && echo "writable /usr" && rm -f /usr/.writetest || echo "NOT writable /usr"
echo "--- apk cache / root check ---"
ls -ld /var/cache/apk 2>&1
echo "--- sudo? ---"
which sudo 2>/dev/null || echo "no sudo"
